connect.title: Connect Search Console
connect.body: Clicks, impressions and positions for {site} are fetched every night once Search Console is connected. Until then no figures are shown.
connect.noSite: No public website is registered for {app}, so there is nothing to connect.
connect.ownerOnly: Only the owner can connect Search Console.
connect.step1: Create a service account in a Google Cloud project (IAM & Admin › Service accounts) and create a JSON key for it.
connect.step2: Turn on the «Google Search Console API» in the same project.
connect.step3: Add the service account's email address as a user on {site} in Search Console (Settings › Users and permissions). Restricted access is enough.
connect.keyNote: The key goes straight to the vault and is never shown again. Only the account's email address is kept visible.
connect.badKey: This is not a JSON key for a service account.
connect.connected: Search Console is connected. {mapped} of {sites} websites found, {rows} rows fetched.

searchConsole.neverImported: Not fetched yet: the figures arrive tonight, or press «Fetch now».
searchConsole.noProperty: The account {email} has no access to {site} in Search Console. Add it as a user there and press «Check again».
searchConsole.error: Google did not accept the connection ({code}).
searchConsole.disconnected: Search Console is disconnected. The figures already fetched stay.

codes.bad_key: This is not a valid JSON key for a service account.

codes.http_403: The account may not read Search Console. Turn on the Search Console API in the project and give the account access to the property.
codes.expired: The one-time number expired. Try again.
codes.unreachable: Could not reach the service. Try again shortly.
